name: manual_09f54d
claim: A release/test tag that doesn't yet contain the real work its version number implies (e.g. a periscope.N generation tag cut before the Nth integrative merge actually lands) does not need a corrected or superseding tag -- the tag naming convention already embeds the commit short-SHA, so the real release just gets its own tag with a different SHA suffix once the work lands.

decisions.notes: User confirmed 2026-07-30: cut v0.40.2-periscope.3-c3f3d028 from merged's tip to test the release pipeline (PyPI publish, Tauri signing) before the actual third AgentsView integrative merge had landed on merged. Flagged the mismatch (tag claims a generation that isn't there yet); user's response was that this is fine and not worth fixing, since SHA-suffixed tags are naturally non-colliding -- the eventual real v0.40.2-periscope.3-<real-merge-sha> tag coexists without needing to delete/replace the pipeline-test tag.
